name: Guest Book
title: Guest Book: operator and guest paths and what can go wrong

BANDS.t: Choose the restaurant and entry point
BANDS.s: A guest can arrive through staff entry, commerce or an import.
Match contact details and keep purchases with the correct person.
Validate the file, track partial progress and recover rejected rows.
Use segments, filters and individual records to answer operator questions.
Maintain segment rules, spending bands and guest attributes.
Carry permissions, preferences and balances into the products that use them.

NODES.d: Choose the restaurant and open Guest Book Overview or Configure.
e: Counts from another location remain visible during a switch

NODES.d: Add guest takes a US phone number and accepts email and birthday. The form supplies the country prefix.
e: A national number already containing a prefix is entered twice
An incorrect birthday is accepted as a genuine date
Birthday message arrives on the wrong day

NODES.d: At the Android register, staff look up a guest by phone and attach the matching profile to the ticket, or enter the details for a new guest. A temporary ticket name identifies the order. Online ordering, receipt contact and card matching are separate entry points.
e: A family shares a phone and one person's visit attaches to another
A receipt contact is treated as permission to send promotions

NODES.t: Receive a loyalty or card event
NODES.d: Loyalty transactions update guest activity. Gift card purchaser and recipient can be different people, so check whose card and history appear.
e: A gifted card appears under the buyer instead of the intended recipient
Guest receives loyalty credit under a temporary payment profile

NODES.d: Newsletter, Sign Up and Contact Us popups can create or link a guest and assign the Potential segment. The guest update can fail after the visitor receives confirmation of the form submission.
e: A form submission is counted as a marketable guest without a matching opt in
Guest Book update fails after the website accepts a submission
A real lead is missing from the audience

NODES.d: At the Android register, the Add Guest phone lookup displays the matched contact before staff attach it to the ticket. Payment and import services have their own matching rules, including email fallback where supported. Manual creation can reject an existing email or phone.
e: Formatting variants create two entries for one person
A reused phone conflicts with an existing email identity
A guest is linked to the wrong person

NODES.d: A customer identity and its association with the restaurant are separate. Check that the local association exists when an existing guest orders at a new branch.
e: A recognised customer has no link to the new branch
A contact change propagates to an unrelated profile

NODES.d: The payment service can merge a card-created guest into an identified ticket customer. Android POS resolves the receipt name from the ticket and linked customer fields and suppresses recognised placeholder names. Compare the receipt with the attached profile.
e: Temporary and identified records both keep the same visit
A placeholder name reaches the printed receipt after a change to receipt formatting

NODES.d: When Android POS finds a returning guest, the cashier sees the saved name and attaches the profile by customer ID. This flow has no name-edit field. A temporary ticket name and a correction to the saved Guest Book profile are separate actions.
e: A returning guest asks to correct their name and the cashier can only attach the existing profile from this screen
The stored name still needs correction in Guest Book
Correcting a shared contact changes the wrong guest name
Subsequent receipts identify the wrong person

NODES.d: In Configure, open the Guest Book import drawer and select the platform whose column layout matches the file.
e: A loyalty upload is interpreted as a guest file
Progress for a loyalty import appears as guest import progress
Operator waits for the wrong job

NODES.d: The drawer advertises CSV and Excel up to 5 MB. The server checks the platform columns and whether any valid customers remain.
e: Wrong headers reject the file before the first row is saved
A spreadsheet converts a phone number or strips leading digits
Rows no longer match existing contacts

NODES.d: Normalisation separates accepted rows, invalid records and duplicates before or during processing, depending on the source format.
e: Repeated contacts within the upload inflate successful counts
Migration looks more complete than it is
Rows with no usable contact details appear eligible

NODES.d: Import uses source-specific subscription data when supplied. Eligibility must be checked independently for email and marketing texts. A qualifying points import can also trigger a separate loyalty welcome text after the row commits.
e: A missing SMS preference becomes an explicit opt in
Reimport replaces a recorded opt out with an older preference

NODES.d: Inspect the current restaurant and import type. Cancellation can occur after some records have been processed.
e: Cancel is interpreted as undoing completed rows
Progress remains active after a worker stops
Manager cannot tell which rows completed

NODES.d: Review the failed records file, correct the source rows and retry only the affected entries.
e: The failure file omits the original row or conflict
Retrying the complete file obscures which rows were already accepted

NODES.d: Search the list, inspect segment cards, sort and load additional rows. The name or contact may differ from the original import.
e: A retained segment excludes the matching phone number
Pagination repeats the final row after a sort change

NODES.d: Apply guest attributes and order or spend ranges. The date filter starts at All time and can combine with a selected segment.
e: Date and count filters together hide a recent guest
Clearing visible filters leaves a separate segment active

NODES.d: Open a row to load the guest and restaurant together. Overview and Activity are distinct profile tabs.
e: Switching guests briefly displays the previous person's contact details
A failed profile lookup looks like a guest with no activity

NODES.d: Inspect the displayed name, contact details, birthday, tags and loyalty or gift card summary where available.
e: Outdated email remains after profile correction
Next email reaches an old address
A missing balance is rendered as a genuine zero

NODES.d: Activity includes order history with date, order number and total spend. Open an available order detail and match it to the original ticket.
e: A refund is shown as a second positive purchase
Spend and visit history are overstated
Gift card purchase value is confused with food order spend

NODES.d: Open the guest profile to see rewards and the cards linked at this restaurant. For a self-purchase inspect the buyer. For a gift inspect the linked recipient. Open card activity and any available receipt, including separate purchase and refund events.
e: Points from a reversed order remain in the summary
A gift is checked against the buyer while it belongs to the linked recipient

NODES.d: Configure the visit or inactivity criteria for the available guest segments. Review the thresholds used by Regular and Lost journeys.
e: Shortening the lost threshold moves many guests into reminders at once
Threshold change is saved for the wrong restaurant

NODES.d: Configure Economy, Standard and the higher spend band. Validate adjacent monetary boundaries and decimals before saving.
e: A guest exactly at the boundary is counted twice
Spend fields save while a separate segment update fails
Operator believes all settings took effect

NODES.d: Segment and spend calculations use restaurant activity. Compare the guest profile, segment count and downstream audience after a change.
e: The card updates before individual guest memberships
Displayed and actual audience sizes differ
A refunded or cancelled order still qualifies a guest for a spend tier

NODES.d: Review the available tag and allergen groups and their association with the selected guest. Campaign filters can consume them.
e: Removing a tag leaves a saved audience unexpectedly empty
An allergen label from another guest appears on the profile

NODES.d: Email subscription and promotional SMS consent are recorded separately. On the Android customer-facing loyalty signup, the guest chooses whether to receive promotions and the app sends that choice with the signup. A phone number supplied for a receipt alone does not establish that choice.
e: A phone captured for a receipt is included in a promotional audience
Email opt out also suppresses an unrelated permitted channel

NODES.d: Campaigns snapshot eligible guests when submitted. Journeys evaluate their own trigger and channel eligibility. Reconcile the time of selection.
e: A manager compares a saved campaign with today's larger segment
A guest who changed segment still enters an inappropriate reminder

NODES.d: The guest can unsubscribe from email or change marketing SMS consent by reply. The SMS worker uses the provider decision or recognised STOP, START or UNSTOP text, and writes the matched guest and restaurant preference. Check the next send independently.
e: A later import re-enables the withdrawn channel
Marketing resumes against the guest's preference
An already queued send uses an earlier consent snapshot
Opted out guest still receives a message

NODES.d: Verify the authorised route for correction, access or erasure of a guest record and its downstream copies. The Guest Book controller inspected exposes no operator erasure flow.
e: Staff remove a profile from a visible list while a downstream copy remains contactable
A shared phone is treated as proof of identity for erasure

NODES.d: Recheck the intended restaurant, guest and destination surface after a change or import.
e: Only a list count is verified after merging profiles
Points or history remain attached to the wrong person

NODES.d: After a committed import with positive points, check whether the guest is reachable, has previously been welcomed, and qualifies as new, previously at zero points, or without a ticket. Record an accepted welcome so a later import can skip it.
e: An accepted welcome is not recorded before an import is retried
The guest may receive a duplicate balance message
An imported guest has points but no reachable number
The balance is recorded without a welcome text

NOTES: Gift card activity in the profile reads transaction records. A loyalty welcome following an eligible import is transactional. Marketing text eligibility still depends on the guest consent record.

Android POS internal d2b5329 was checked in AddCustomerFragment, TicketReceiptMapper and the customer-facing loyalty signup. Payment identity merges, privacy requests and cancellation of an in-flight import depend on their respective services. Three website popup types create guests.
PROD 5045 is a request for an existing-name edit on POS. PROD 4966 documents the dummy guest on a receipt and also appears in Loyalty.
